observation: One star plug, one solid. Iso: a square flange over a deeper square plug body, granulation engraved into the flange corners, and two tapered flames rising from one edge. Top: the two flames sit on one edge as designed and the flange is otherwise clear. Front: the flange stands proud of the plug body as a continuous lip all the way round and the two flames rise off it with no step at their feet. No missing, extra or floating geometry and no visible intersection.
